Title: Classification of hERG blockers and nonblockers
Description: Separates hERG blockers from non-blockers using deephERG, built by Cai and colleagues from a large set of compounds with reported channel activity. Rather than a single cut-off, the training labels used a deliberate gap: compounds with IC50 below 10 uM count as actives and those above 80 uM as inactives, leaving ambiguous intermediate potencies out of the fit. That choice sharpens the decision boundary but means the model has never seen the borderline chemistry where cardiac risk is often hardest to call.
Interpretation: Probability of hERG blockade, with actives defined below 10 uM and inactives above 80 uM.
